person_sheets.note: Known IDs route directly. A rostered core composes with its declared cohort/host baseline when one exists; identity-only world cores do not invent capability.

npc_development.note: Load person + current health/training/experience inputs. No free growth.

character_behavior.note: Normal exact-character interaction. If inline behavior is insufficient and interaction is sustained/high-stakes, load exactly one cold behavior profile.

character_behavior_profile.note: Cold non-authoritative evidence constraint. Known owner_id -> direct profile from index; never load all profiles.
